verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's vertical rhythm with no collisions, but the SOLSTICE logo is small and pushed up close to the top edge, and the lower third is dead space, as in the original. B moves the logo lower and tightens the headline-to-CTA gap, but a bokeh dot sits on the 'E' of SOLSTICE, and putting all the content in the upper 60% leaves the bottom feeling emptier and the layout top-heavy.
